title: Alibaba Cloud Summit: Zhenwu M890 AI Chip Claims 3x Nvidia H20 Performance, Qwen 3.7-Max Released for 35-Hour Agentic Coding
detail: At the Alibaba Cloud Summit in Hangzhou on May 20, 2026, Alibaba's semiconductor arm T-Head (Pingtou Ge / 平头哥半导体) unveiled the Zhenwu M890 AI accelerator, claiming performance at 3x the previous-generation 810E chip and 3x the Nvidia H20 — the downgraded Hopper chip that has been the only Nvidia product legally available to China since the April 2025 H20 restriction. Key M890 specifications: 144 GB HBM3 memory, 800 GB/s inter-chip bandwidth, purpose-built for agentic AI workloads requiring sustained multi-step reasoning and long-horizon task completion. Alibaba disclosed that 560,000+ Zhenwu-series chips have already been shipped to 400+ enterprise customers across 20 industries including automotive, finance, healthcare, and retail — a deployment scale that rivals Huawei Ascend's reported installed base. Simultaneously, Alibaba released Qwen 3.7-Max, optimized for long-duration coding and multi-step reasoning with autonomous sessions up to 35 continuous hours, targeting enterprise software development and agentic AI workflow automation. The strategic significance of the Zhenwu M890 is acute: if the 3x-H20 performance claim is validated by independent benchmarks, it means Alibaba has domestically surpassed the chip that was calibrated to be 'sufficient for AI inference but not for frontier training' — the H20's raison d'être as an export-controlled downgrade. Alibaba released the M890 one day before Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang publicly acknowledged that Nvidia has 'largely conceded' China's AI chip market to domestic alternatives. Context: Alibaba recorded its first operating loss since the 2021 tech crackdown in Q1 2026 (announced May 13), attributing the loss directly to AI infrastructure investment. The Zhenwu M890's 560K+ unit deployment is the first product-level validation that this investment is producing competitive domestic hardware. As of May 20, independent benchmark verification of the 3x-H20 claim was not publicly available.
